Release notes: 0.13.1 → 0.13.6 (2 releases) #### [0.13.6](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.13.6) ##### Release Notes Released on 2026-10-26. ###### Enhancements - Accept an empty `UV_RUN_RECURSION_DEPTH` as zero and report invalid values consistently ([#22814](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22814)) - Explain how to add project metadata when `uv init` finds a `pyproject.toml` without a `[project]` table ([#22916](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22916)) ###### Python - Add CPython 3.11.18, 3.12.16, 3.13.18, 3.14.10, and 3.15.2 ([#22938](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22938)) ###### Preview features - Detect NVIDIA GPU capabilities when selecting compatible wheel variants with `wheel-variants` ([#22690](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22690)) - Nest each module's owners in an object in `uv workspace metadata` output ([#22638](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22638)) - Report the unsupported properties required by an incompatible wheel variant ([#22719](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22719)) ###### Performance - Reduce peak memory use when resolving large workspaces ([#22860](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22860), [#22863](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22863), [#22864](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22864), [#22866](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22866), [#22870](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22870)) - Reduce peak memory use when locking or upgrading large projects ([#22833](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22833), [#22834](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22834)) - Speed up redirected output from `uv export` and `uv pip compile` ([#22840](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22840)) - Reuse cached or active environments when running PEP 723 scripts without dependencies ([#21458](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21458)) - Reduce parsing overhead for build dependency and build backend settings ([#22848](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22848), [#22871](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22871), [#22879](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22879), [#22884](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22884)) - Reduce parsing overhead for project sources and workspace references ([#22880](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22880), [#22883](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22883)) - Reduce parsing overhead for cache, exclusion, cutoff, and preview settings ([#22876](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22876), [#22877](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22877), [#22878](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22878), [#22887](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22887)) - Reduce PyPI metadata parsing overhead ([#22874](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22874), [#22875](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22875)) - Speed up parsing tool receipt requirements ([#22885](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22885)) ###### Bug fixes - Prevent `uv run --active --script` and `uv sync --active --script` from deleting non-virtual-environment directories ([#21464](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21464)) - Use `AMD64` for `platform_machine` when resolving for x86-64 Windows ([#22935](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22935)) - Preserve free-threaded and other non-default variants in `uv python upgrade` ([#22836](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22836)) - Allow `uv init --no-package` and `uv init --script` when `UV_INIT_BUILD_BACKEND` is set ([#22907](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22907)) - Prevent panics when rendering containment markers with local versions ([#22815](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22815)) ###### Documentation - Update the Docker guide and reproduction examples to use uv 0.13.5 ([#22867](https://redirect.github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22867)) ##### Install uv 0.13.6 ###### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script ```sh curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.6/uv-installer.sh | sh ``` ###### Install prebuilt binaries
